Here is an overview of connectors used in the engine harness of M52TU and M54.

Feel free to add partnumbers if you find them useful.

==Sensor Connectors==
=====BMW M54 Crankshaft Sensor=====
*'''ECU Side:''' Kostal 3 Way Sealed SLK 2,8 Black Female Connector (Coding A) - '''09-4413-91 // 9441391''' 
**Pin: Female SLK 2,8 Sealed Tin Plated Terminal 0.5-0.75mm² - '''22140492060'''
**Seal: Individual Loose Cable Seal SLK 2,8 Series 1.5-2.5mm² - '''10800444523'''
*'''Sensor Side:''' Kostal 3 Way Sealed SLK 2,8 Black Male Connector (Coding A) - '''1-968408-2 // '''
**Pin: Male SLK 2,8 Sealed Silver Plated Terminal 0.5-0.75mm² - '''10124499140'''
**Seal: Individual Loose Cable Seal SLK 2,8 Series 1.5-2.5mm² - '''10800444523'''

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Pin 1
|| M_KWG (Sensor Ground)
|-
! Pin 2
|| P_KWG (Crankshaft Sensor Signal Output)
|-
! Pin 3
|| U_HR (+12V Voltage Input)
|}

=====BMW M52TU M54 Lambda Sensor Connectors=====
These connectors describe the probe side. ECU wiring side is exactly the other connector.

'''Pre Catalytic Converter Lambda Probe:'''
*Housing: BMW 12521740485
*Pin: BMW 12521744077
*Sealing: BMW 1427785
*Cable Protection: BMW 12521703593

[[File:Pre Cat Lambda Sensor Connector.png|450px]]


'''Post Catalytic Converter Lambda Probe :'''
*Housing: BMW 12521740486
*Pin: BMW 1703596
*Sealing: BMW 1427785
*Cable Protection: BMW 12521703593

[[File:Post Cat Lambda Sensor Connector.png|450px]]

===== BMW B58 Throttle Body (13548623324) =====
The B58 throttle body adapts perfectly to MS43 and can therefore be used on a B58 manifold that has been adapted for use on an M5X engine.

Plug: 12527635615 (BMW) / 1-1718646-1 (TE) / 4F0973706 (VAG)

Pins: 61138600419 (BMW) / 2141970-1 (TE)

|-
! Pin 4
